div.div: مُنَجَّذٌ (assumed tropical:) A man (S, L) tried and strengthened by experience; expert, or experienced: (T, S, L, K:) or (so in the L; in the K, and) who has experienced probations, trials, or calamities, (Lh, L, K,) and thus become a vigorous manager of affairs. (TA.) See also مُنَجَّدٌ.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
